source_basis: 02_CHARACTERS_AND_RELATIONSHIPS_BIBLE: identity-specific posture, gait, combat/personality separation, companion/cinematic handoff checks
07_MISSION_AND_CHAPTER_IMPLEMENTATION_MATRIX: chapter ownership and fixed film outcomes
08_VISUAL_REFERENCE_BIBLE: location hero landmarks, cinematic anchors, chapter/state-specific visual references
11_MASTER_PRODUCTION_SYSTEMS_AND_SOURCE_INDEX: source lock -> blocking -> camera plan -> performance -> gameplay seam -> QA

camera: Use close framing for decisions, grief, temptation and relationship turns rather than constantly.
Battle framing may be kinetic only if playable direction is re-established before control returns.
Runtime preview cameras must never steal view control from authored Level Sequences.
All temporary camera accents return to the prior player view and own no quest/save state.
performance: Named characters share technology but retain distinct gesture, gaze, body-weight and composure profiles.
Frodo is not treated as a conventional power-fantasy warrior.
Gandalf remains measured; magic/presentation is rare and purposeful.
Legolas emphasizes precision and economy of motion.
Gimli emphasizes weight without reducing him to comedy.
Boromir remains tragic and human, not villain-coded.
Sam's supportive presence reads as active courage rather than comic-only behavior.

rules: Gameplay-only cues do not trigger camera accents.
GameplayBlend and Cinematic cues use bounded establishing/emotional profiles.
Named-subject shots are attempted for Bilbo, Aragorn, Elrond, Gandalf, Galadriel, Boromir and Sam at relevant story beats.
Collision trace shortens camera placement instead of clipping through geometry.
A camera accent is skipped if another authored camera already owns the view.
Maximum runtime accent hold is 2.60 seconds, below the existing 3.5 second input-lock safety cap.

named_profiles.Gandalf: restrained gesture, moderate gaze, low body sway, very high composure
named_profiles.Saruman: restrained authoritative gesture, low sway, very high composure
named_profiles.Aragorn: economical gesture, alert gaze, grounded stance, high composure
named_profiles.Boromir: broader gesture, stronger weight shift, higher emotional volatility
named_profiles.Legolas: minimal gesture, precise gaze, low sway, very high composure
named_profiles.Gimli: heavier weight shift and stronger gesture with controlled gaze
named_profiles.Sam: warm attentive gaze and moderate practical gesture
named_profiles.Pippin: quicker expressive motion with lower composure
